answer.approach: Build blog article as semantic markup first; use utilities for spacing, layout, type and state feedback. Include this evidence: <article, <h1, leading-, <blockquote, <ul.
review_checklist: Test keyboard focus and narrow-screen layout.
Check meaningful alternative text and contrast when relevant.
